title: One Hundred Thousand Years of Qi Refining Episode 374 English Sub
description:
One hundred thousand years ago, Tian Lanzong repaired the real world, and the disciples in Zong were all arrogant and invincible. Xu Yang, the disciple of Kaishan alone, has been in the refining period. Xu Yang has been closed for thousands of years in order to break through and repair as soon as possible. Who knows that when the customs clearance is over, Tian Lanzong has only three or five disciples left. When he sees it, he will destroy the case, Xu Yang will repel the strong enemy, and vow to lead Tianlangzong back to the top！ As Tianyanzong's power expanded, Xu Yang's stagnation truth was also revealed step by step. Over the years, a secret that permeated the three realms of man, demon, and fairyland was also shown in front of everyone！Is it a thought of God, or a thought of a demon？The life and death of the world is between Xu Yang's palms！
